items.description: Enemies' buffs are removed, and your creatures gain those buffs.

items.name: Black Ice
items.description: Each enemy has a 50% chance to be afflicted with Frozen, and each of your creatures have a 50% chance to gain Invisible.

items.name: Chaos Transformation
items.description: When your creatures buff an enemy, they debuff them instead. When your creatures debuff an ally, they buff them instead. This trait does not stack.

items.name: Explosive Armor · Siegemaster
items.description:
After your creatures defend, they gain 10% defense and a Barrier that absorbs the same amount of defense. If the creature already has a Barrier, it explodes, dealing damage to enemies equal to 50% of the Barrier strength.

Barrier absorbs a certain amount of damage. After the maximum amount of damage is dealt, the buff is removed. Barrier strength cannot exceed 200% of a creature's highest stat when this buff is applied.

items.name: Going Mad
items.description: After this creature takes damage from an attack or spell, it gains a random buff. After this creature is healed, it gains a random debuff. After this creature takes damage from an attack or spell while it has at least 15 buffs and debuffs, it deals damage to enemies equal to 50% of its lowest stat (other than health).

items.name: Parasites
items.description: Enemies are afflicted with Blighted and Leeching.

items.name: Petra & Aes, War Drums of Meraxis
Radiant Sunfire
items.description: Your creatures gain a random buff and enemies are afflicted with a random debuff for each enemy with Burning.

items.name: Soul Reaver
items.description: After this creature damages an enemy, it steals their buffs and minions and gives them its debuffs. In addition, your creatures' buffs and minions last forever, and enemies' debuffs last forever.

items.name: The Nether
items.description: At the start of your other creatures' turns, this creature performs an action depending on that creature's class. Chaos - Attack a random enemy. Death - Enemies are afflicted with a random debuff. Life - Your creatures gain a random buff. Nature - Your creatures gain 10% stats. Sorcery - Cast one of their Spell Gems. This trait does not stack.

items.name: Poison Inoculation
items.description: Your creatures start battle with Poisoned. Your creatures recover health from Poisoned instead of taking damage from it.

items.name: Bad Blood
items.description: After your creatures are killed, this creature afflicts enemies with Poisoned, Burning and Bleeding.

items.name: Bang-A-Rang
items.description: After an enemy takes damage from Bomb, this creature afflicts it with Burning and Poisoned. If the enemy already has these debuffs, their potency is increased by 30% instead.

items.name: Contagion
items.description: After an enemy dodges, this creature afflicts it with Poisoned and Silenced.

items.name: Contamination
items.description: This creature's attacks deal 75% more damage and afflict Poisoned.

items.name: Dead of Winter
items.description: After an enemy afflicts a debuff, it is afflicted with Frozen and Poisoned.

items.name: Gore
items.description: After your Waspids attack, they afflict the target with Poisoned and Bleeding.

items.name: Here to Die
items.description: After an enemy is afflicted with either Bleeding or Poisoned, this creature afflicts them with whichever of these debuffs the target doesn't already have.

items.name: Hunter's Season
items.description: After this creature attacks, it deals damage to a random enemy equal to 35% of the attack's damage and afflicts them with Poisoned. This effect repeats once for each Hunter fighting on your side.

items.name: Scoundrel's Strike
items.description: Toxic Frogmania cast by your creatures always deals massive damage based on the caster's lowest stat and afflicts the target with Poisoned. The potency of the spell is increased by 20% for each unique class among your creatures. This trait does not stack.

items.name: Spit Poison
items.description: After this creature is attacked, it afflicts enemies with Poisoned. If enemies already have this debuff, its potency is increased by 30% instead.

items.name: Toxic Karma
items.description: After this creature is attacked, the enemy is afflicted with Poisoned and Bomb.
